Splitting the fraction into separate terms and then simplifying the fractions in individual terms, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{4a+10b-12c}{8} & = \\ \frac{4a}{8}+\frac{10b}{8}-\frac{12c}{8} & = \\ \frac{4}{8}\cdot a+\frac{10}{8}\cdot b-\frac{12}{8}\cdot c & = \\ \frac{1}{2}\cdot a+\frac{5}{4}\cdot b-\frac{3}{2}\cdot c & = \\ \frac{a}{2}+\frac{5b}{4}-\frac{3c}{2} & .\end{aligned}
$$
